name: Teklafalu (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Teklafalu: a shield of red and blue with a church and a figure, with blue and yellow mantling and a scroll inscribed TEKLAFALU.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Teklafalu arms with mantling and scroll
